title: Antigravity operator surface
summary: Antigravity operator surface — the operator engages DontPanic from within the Antigravity agentic environment.

verify.readiness: Antigravity surface is usable when PATH resolves dontpanic, the DontPanic home directory is present, the repo is visible, any declared worktree binding is healthy, the operator config is valid, and MCP is reachable from the Antigravity environment.

dontpanic_core: invocation context resolution for antigravity surface
canonical surface id from F001 OperatorSurface enum
operator: installs and runs the Antigravity environment
configures DontPanic access from within Antigravity

mutation_boundary.allowed_path: Operator surface manifests are read-only descriptors; DontPanic does not mutate the Antigravity environment or its configuration.
forbidden: DontPanic must not write to Antigravity environment settings directly

notes: Antigravity is an external operator surface; DontPanic does not bundle or install it.
MCP availability probe checks whether the DontPanic MCP server endpoint is reachable from within the Antigravity environment.
